svg.title: Green Lantern — reviewed circuit
svg.text: Green Lantern power battery — circuit revision
Matching net names are connected. All grounds are common. Dots join wires; unmarked crossings do not.
Pack switch ON for use/charge; S1 OFF to charge.
Use supplied 12.6 V charger; J1 switched contact unused.
JP1 fitted: battery operation, USB unplugged.
JP1 removed: USB powers XIAO; S1 powers U1/loads.
Never connect USB with JP1 fitted.
USB-only flashing: remove U1 from its socket first.
Optional PRIME: D6 → momentary button → GND
U1 — TC4427CPA dual non-inverting gate driver
C3 + C4: short leads directly across pins 6 and 3.
C5 goes at the sensor, after the cable; OUT connects directly to D1.
No 5 V pull-up and no series diode on HALL.
D3 stripe toward NO; NC unused.
R11 supplies ~1.5 mA when closed; GPIO stays at 3.3 V.
LOCK CABLE (JST PH 4-pin): +5V_REG, HALL, SW_NO (D3 cathode), GND. R9–R11 and D3 stay on the board.
LED CABLE (JST SM 2-pin): VLOAD and Q2 drain. Keep pump/LED return currents out of sensor/MCU wiring.
USB service: see build guide power sequence. JP1 only isolates the XIAO supply, not its GPIO connections.
CAD FOLLOW-UP: existing battery supports fit the old KBT pack; TalentCell fit is a separate PR.
